blocks.text:
Breakfast and transfer to the airport for your flight to Foz do Iguaçu. Meeting with your driver on arrival and transfer to your selected hotel.

The rest of the day is at leisure. The change of pace after bustling Rio is immediately apparent: the city is surrounded by subtropical forest, while the region’s main natural attraction lies beyond the urban area.

This break before visiting the falls is especially welcome because the next two days involve walking and time close to the water. In Foz do Iguaçu, you can enjoy a relaxed dinner, prepare light clothing and protect your camera and other equipment from spray. The region’s main highlights begin the following morning, when the itinerary takes you into the national park.

Iguazu comprises numerous separate cascades. The river reaches a long line of basalt cliffs and splits into streams, some concealed by the forest. A fine mist hangs almost constantly above the gorge. Over the next two days, you will see the falls from both the Brazilian and Argentine sides.
